_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.
subject: Use when designing or reviewing asynchronous event contracts: producer/consumer ownership, event envelope, schema,…

cases.scenario: A user asks: "design the event contract for publishing OrderPaid to downstream consumers"
cases.context: The agent has access to the event-contract-design skill and must decide whether to use it, apply its procedure, and stay inside its boundaries.
cases.question: What should the agent do, and why is event-contract-design the right skill to apply?
expected_flags: Recognizes event-contract-design as applicable to this request
Uses the skill-specific purpose or mental model instead of generic advice
Names the relevant boundary against api-design, state-machine-modeling, entity-relationship-modeling
Turns the request into concrete steps, checks, or decisions from the skill
expected_fix_hints: Apply the event-contract-design workflow to the concrete scenario
State the next action and the evidence or verification needed
Call out any adjacent skill that should own a different part of the request
absent_signals: Does not answer with generic advice that could ignore event-contract-design
